prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision at the intersection described in your insured's report. Our client sustained injuries that are still under evaluation and expects to require ongoing medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to the driver and vehicle involved, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, repair and total-loss records, telematics, and all internal notes and recorded statements. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
